components.name: FaqSection
components.doc: A frequently asked questions section in three layouts: one centered accordion, a category rail beside its questions, and a searchable list that filters and highlights as you type. Answers open on a height spring with the icon turning to a close mark; arrow keys move between questions.

components.name: FaqSectionBlock
components.doc: Preview: the FAQ with a switch between its three layouts.

members.name: id
members.doc: Stable id used for open state. Defaults to the question.

members.name: answer
members.doc: Plain text answer; it is also what search matches.

members.name: category
members.doc: Groups questions in the columns variant.

members.name: variant
members.doc: `accordion` is one centered list, `columns` groups questions beside a category rail, `search` filters as you type.

members.name: multiple
members.doc: Allow several answers open at once. Defaults to false.

members.name: defaultValue
members.doc: Initially open item ids when uncontrolled.

members.name: category
members.doc: Active category in the columns variant (controlled).

members.name: query
members.doc: Search text in the search variant (controlled).

members.name: contact
members.type: { label: string; description?: string; href?: string; onClick?: () => void } | null
members.doc: A way to reach a person when the answer isn't here. Pass null to hide it.
